svg.title: A log-likelihood with one flat direction
svg.desc: Left panel: parallel level lines in the alpha-beta plane, with the maximizing line alpha plus beta equals 3.2 drawn thick and three dots on it. Right panel: a sharp downward parabola across the ridge and a flat horizontal line along it.
svg.text: A likelihood that never learns one direction
level sets in the parameter plane
A flat direction is not a numerical nuisance. It says the data never learn it.
